description: Find ingested provider alerts for Jasper Sleet sign-in activity.

evidence.claim: Microsoft documented North Korean actors adopting AI, identified Onyx Sleet and Pearl Sleet using ARTEX, and listed Defender detections for Jasper Sleet sign-ins and Sapphire Sleet-related ProcmacSteal payloads.
evidence.location: AI-assisted development, operational scaling and Microsoft Defender detections

expected_output: One row per matching event in tabular mode. A match supports triage.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Find ingested provider alerts for Jasper Sleet sign-in activity.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: North Korea · Jasper Sleet Sign-in Alerts

1.json:
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AlertName has_all ("Jasper", "Sleet") and (AlertName contains "sign-in" or AlertName has "signin")
| project TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, ProductName, CompromisedEntity, SystemAlertId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
